thread:
Alex: quick flag — Qwen-7B onboarding showed a perf regression after #kernel-swap, ~2x latency on short-chat workloads :thinking_face:
Maya: ugh, observed that too on the nightly runs. tail latency spike at 95th, throughput dropped. any profiling yet? :eyes:
Sam: I pulled a perf trace. looks like batching heuristics started grouping very short-seq requests into large micro-batches which blows up kv-cache pressure. attaching snippet from trace: 
```
Batch sizes: [1,1,1,8,12,1,1] -> observed concurrent KV swaps
KV cache misses spiked +340% during kernel A->B transition
CPU spin on memcpy_safetensors_conversion
```
Sam: also noticed RoPE scaling mismatch warnings in hf-parser logs: missing `rotary_scale` in safetensors metadata — fallback path picks generic rotary kernel which is incompatible with new kernel tiling pattern
Lina: can you paste the hf config header? maybe missing head_dim or kv_dim fields cause the runtime to pick wrong kernel.
Sam: sure, short excerpt:
```
{"model_type":"qwen","hidden_size":4096,"num_attention_heads":32,"rotary_pct":0.25}
```
Sam: no explicit `rotary_scale` or `kv_head_dim` fields. HF parser infers head dim=128 but kernel expects 160 (mix of old vs new conversion).
Maya: that would cause stride mismatch — kernel assumes different packed layout so KV read/write patterns become non-coalesced -> huge perf hit.
Alex: proposal: add a parser lint that errors on missing kv_head_dim/rotary_scale for Qwen variants and a safe kernel-selection guard: if inferred dims != kernel expected => fallback to reference kernel (slower but stable) and emit actionable warning.
Ryan: +1. we already have a `kernel_selector` table; add an entry for dimension expectations and a lint in convert_safetensors. Example patch idea:
```
if inferred_head_dim != kernel_meta.head_dim:
    log.warn("head_dim mismatch, falling back to reference kernel: inferred=%d expected=%d", inferred_head_dim, kernel_meta.head_dim)
    select_kernel('reference')
```
Maya: also tweak batcher heuristic: cap micro-batch aggregation for requests with seq_len <= 32 to prevent mixing with longer seqs. quick config: `micro_batch_max_tokens=128` for short requests.
Lina: I'll add a unit test that constructs a fake safetensors metadata missing rotary_scale and asserts parser warns and that kernel selector chooses reference.
Infra-bot: nightly-run: qwen7b-end2end failed (regression detected) — build 2026-03-18T07:12:00Z — failure: tail_latency>baseline by 95th perc.
Alex: thanks infra-bot — Lina/Maya/Sam can you own a small PR today to add the lint + batcher cap? we should ship a canary before next deploy.
Sam: will do. I'll also add a perf trace hook to record KV swap counts per request so we can quantitatively detect thrash.
Maya: ping me on the PR, I'll run targeted perf harness against canary. :thumbsup:
Alex: cool. follow-ups: 1) PR for parser lint/kernel guard, 2) batcher cap change + e2e perf test, 3) telemetry for kv-swap events. aim for canary by EOD.
Ryan: logging note — include the model commit hash and safetensors metadata dump in the warning to make triage faster.
Alex: agreed. thanks team. :rocket:
